Hong Kong's Chow Sang Sang discloses a breach; card digits are among the data possibly taken since 9 November.

Names, emails, phones and card digits may have been extracted; police and the Privacy Commissioner are notified. SOGO disclosed an 820,000-member breach the same week; the stock fell 2.2% at Friday's open.

周生生指系統遭未經授權存取，客戶與員工資料可能被提取，包括信用卡末四位數字，事件11月9日首次識別，已通報警方及私隱署；同期崇光百貨通報82萬會員資料外洩，周生生股價周五開市一度跌2.2%。

Full story on caratcapital.org, link in bio.
